RootLayout.title: VYZR | Laser engraving on your visor
RootLayout.description: Send us your motorcycle visor; we laser-engrave your design and ship it back. Configure online, pay securely via Shopify.

Announce.promoFreeShipping: Free return shipping on orders over €100

Footer.tagline: You ship your visor, we laser your design. Configure online, work happens in our lab, back to you.

BottomTrust.deliveryBody: Every design is reviewed, engraved, and returned with care.

Home.metaDescription: Custom engraving on motorcycle visors. Send in your visor, upload your design, and get it engraved and returned. Built for real riders.
Home.heroLead: Custom engraving on your motorcycle visor.
Home.heroMeta: From €49 • Tracked return shipping • Design checked before engraving

Featured.title: Real designs. Real riders.
Featured.subtitle: Send yours in. We make it yours.
Featured.body: We don’t sell you a new visor: you send yours in. Pick a look, upload art, or use a template; each product page has a 3D preview (reference). After checkout you’ll get how to ship your visor to our lab.

HowItWorks.pageTitle: Send it in. Get it back yours.
HowItWorks.pageLead: Upload your design, send in your motorcycle visor, and we return it engraved and ready to ride. Every design is reviewed for clean placement and precision before engraving.
HowItWorks.homeLead: Order online, then choose how we receive your visor.
HowItWorks.homeDeliveryTeaser: Ship nationwide or book a local drop-off.
HowItWorks.delivery1Body: Place your order online, then safely ship your visor to us. After engraving, we return it with tracked shipping.
HowItWorks.delivery2Body: Prefer to bring it in person? Schedule a local drop-off appointment for faster processing and personal handoff.
HowItWorks.deliveryImportantBody: Only send or deliver the visor, not the full helmet.
HowItWorks.step1Body:
Choose your setup and upload your design.

Pay securely through our Shopify checkout.
HowItWorks.step2Body:
After checkout, you receive shipping instructions and your order reference.

Ship nationwide or book a local drop-off.
HowItWorks.step3Body: We engrave your confirmed design, quality-check it, and return it with tracking.
HowItWorks.reviewNote: Every design is reviewed before engraving.

Trust.title: Built for real riders
Trust.b1Body:
Pay securely through our Shopify checkout with trusted payment methods.

Your order is confirmed instantly with clear next steps for sending in your visor.
Trust.b2Body:
We engrave the visor you send in, not a replacement.

Every design is checked for clean placement, visibility and precision before engraving.
Trust.b3Body:
Every motorcycle visor is engraved, quality checked and returned with tracked shipping.

Built for clean results and long-lasting durability.

BeforeAfter.title: Your visor before and after our engraving
BeforeAfter.body: Show the same visor the customer sends in: blank in, laser out, so the send-in model is instantly clear.

Reviews.title: Recent buyers
Reviews.subtitle: Real reviews after delivery build conversion. Connect your review app to Shopify and surface the best lines here.
Reviews.q1: Looks expensive in daylight and reads clean on the bike, exactly what I wanted from an upgrade.
Reviews.q2: Checkout was the same trust level as buying gear elsewhere. That sold me before the visor even arrived.

FinalCta.title: Custom visor engraving
FinalCta.body:
VYZR specializes in custom engraving on motorcycle visors.

You send in your own visor, we apply your design, and return it ready to ride.
FinalCta.h3_1Body: Order online, send in your visor, and we return it engraved.
FinalCta.h3_2Body: Upload a logo, text or custom artwork for review before engraving.
FinalCta.h3_3Body: Designs are placed away from your direct line of sight.

Shop.metaDescription: Pick a laser-engraving design for your own motorcycle visor. Configure in 3D (preview), checkout on Shopify, then send your visor to our lab.
Shop.fallbackDescription: Each listing is an engraving service on the visor you send in, not a new visor for sale. 3D view is a reference; after checkout you’ll get ship-in instructions.
Shop.fallbackIntro: Choose a design, complete checkout, ship your visor in. We engrave and send it back.
Shop.noShopify: Configure NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN and your Storefront token to load the catalog.
Shop.noProducts: No products yet for this storefront. In Shopify: add products and publish them to your Headless / Online Store channel (Sales channel availability). If you use NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOPIFY_VISORS_COLLECTION_HANDLE, the handle must match an existing collection that contains products.
Shop.visorPhotoHint: Best look: packshots or mockups with the design on the visor.

Product.bullet1: Product photo from the listing. Final engraving follows your confirmed artwork at checkout.
Product.noProductImage: No product photo is set for this item in Shopify. Add a featured image in the admin.
Product.bullet2: Premium laser engraving, crisp at the edge, subtle in the lane.
Product.bullet3: Engineered not to compromise visibility when correctly installed.
Product.bullet4: After payment: instructions to ship your visor to us; we return it tracked after engraving (EU).
Product.pricePickSetup: Prices depend on your setup. Choose step 1 below: the amount updates to match Single, Double, or Full.
Product.bagHint: You’re ordering the engraving service. After checkout you’ll get how to send your visor in. Cart and Shopify checkout work as usual.
Product.trustBuyBody: A premium laser engraving on your own visor, carefully positioned and finished to your approved design. No new visor included.
Product.trustQuote: Finally looks like the helmet I imagined when I bought it.
Product.trustNote: Every design is reviewed before engraving.
Product.attrFulfillmentVyzr: VYZR sources new visor (10% engraving discount)
Product.attrVisorCostSeparate: Visor purchase billed separately at checkout
Product.fulfillmentLabel: How should we get your visor?
Product.fulfillmentHint: Send yours in, let us source a new visor, or drop yours off in person. Sourcing and drop-off both get 10% off the engraving service.
Product.fulfillment_own_visor_body: You ship your visor to our lab after checkout. Standard turnaround.
Product.fulfillment_vyzr_supplies_visor_body: We buy the correct visor for your helmet. Faster delivery, no inbound shipping for you. Visor cost is separate.
Product.fulfillment_dropoff_visor_body: Bring your visor in person. Pick your appointment time before you pay. No shipping costs either way.
Product.fulfillmentDropoffNote: After selecting your visor, a calendar will appear below to pick your drop-off time, then complete your payment.
Product.visorSelectHint: Select the helmet model. Visor price is added to your total. Most popular options are listed first.
Product.visorSelectHintOwn: Select which helmet and visor you are sending in. Same engraving price for every model, no extra charge.
Product.visorSelectRequired: Select a visor from the list before adding to cart.
Product.priceBreakdownCheckoutNote: Visor price is included in your order details at Shopify checkout.
Product.helmetNoteHint: Same price for every model. We only need to know what you ride so we can match the visor.
Product.helmetNoteHintVyzrSupplies: Brand, model, and visor type (e.g. clear, iridium, pinlock). We use this to order the right visor.
Product.helmetNotePlaceholder: e.g. AGV K3, size L, or: sending my own visor
Product.helmetNoteRequired: Enter your helmet and visor before adding to cart.
Product.helmetNoteRequiredVyzr: Enter your helmet and visor model so we can source the correct visor.
Product.wrongVisorDisclaimer: If the helmet or visor details you provide are incorrect and we order the wrong visor, any extra costs (replacement visor, re-shipping, or re-work) are at your expense.
Product.uploadNotConfigured: Design upload is not configured. Add BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (Vercel → Storage → Blob) for production, or run locally without it (dev saves to .local-uploads automatically).
Product.noteVyzrSupplies: Pick your visor from the list. Engraving gets 10% off and we ship faster.
Product.noteOwnVisor: After checkout you'll receive instructions to ship your visor to our lab.
Product.calendlyStepHint: Pick a date and time for your visor drop-off. Your appointment is confirmed once you select a slot. Pay below to complete your order.
Product.calendlyBooked: Appointment selected. Complete your payment below to confirm your order.
Product.calendlyRequired: Select a drop-off time above before proceeding to checkout.

Customizer.title: Your visor, your layout
Customizer.lead: Pick a setup, then upload one design per position. You will see each design on the correct area of the visor preview: left, top (front), and right.
Customizer.setupDesc_single: One engraved area: choose left or right band.
Customizer.setupDesc_double: Left and right bands, our most popular choice.
Customizer.setupDesc_full: Left, top (front), and right: maximum layout control.
Customizer.singleSideHint: Pick which side of the visor to engrave.
Customizer.step2Lead: Each side has its own design.
Customizer.slotLeftHint: PNG, JPG, or SVG. Shown on the left segment of the visor preview.
Customizer.slotRightHint: PNG, JPG, or SVG. Shown on the right segment of the visor preview.
Customizer.slotTopHint: PNG, JPG, or SVG. Center / forehead band, only for full customization.
Customizer.notePreview: This is a preview. Final engraving may vary slightly.
Customizer.noteReview: We review every design before engraving.
Customizer.addToCartLong: Add your custom visor to cart →
